ObservatoryFormal.hoffmanWielandtSquared.{u_1, u_2} {𝕜 : Type u_1} [RCLike 𝕜] {n : Type u_2} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
  {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
  ∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues₀ i - hB.eigenvalues₀ i) ^ 2 ≤ frobSq (A - B)
'ObservatoryFormal.hoffmanWielandtSquared' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
ObservatoryFormal.lipschitzEigenvalueTestSquared.{u_1, u_2} {𝕜 : Type u_1} [RCLike 𝕜] {n : Type u_2} [Fintype n]
  [DecidableEq n] {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
  (hf : ∀ (x y : ℝ), |f x - f y| ≤ C * |x - y|) :
  (∑ i, f (hA.eigenvalues₀ i) - ∑ i, f (hB.eigenvalues₀ i)) ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 * ↑(Fintype.card n) * frobSq (A - B)
'ObservatoryFormal.lipschitzEigenvalueTestSquared' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
scope: Finite sorted-eigenvalue squared displacement and finite Lipschitz empirical-test square bound only, using already built source dependencies. Not a main zeta theorem or weak-law formalization.
